summary: Updates no longer reinstall ZERO. Only its own code is downloaded, under 1 MB, and ZERO restarts on it in a few seconds.
changes: Quick updates: ZERO downloads its new code only and restarts on it, with no installer.
A new update screen with the notes of each version, grouped as New, Improved and Fixed.
What's new: after an update, ZERO shows once what changed.
improvements: Every update is signed. ZERO checks the signature, the size and the SHA-512 before using it.
If a new version fails to start three times in a row, ZERO goes back to the installed one by itself.
The full installer is only used when the Chromium engine changes, and it runs silently.
